meta.name: nft-standards
meta.description: Implement NFT standards (ERC-721, ERC-1155) with proper metadata handling, minting strategies, and marketplace integration. Use when creating NFT contracts, building NFT marketplaces, or implementing digital asset systems.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发行 NFT 数字资产并接入交易市场
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发区块链上的 NFT 项目。
copy.tagline_en: Launch NFT digital assets and integrate with marketplaces.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building NFT projects on blockchain.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 ERC-721 和 ERC-1155 标准帮你写 NFT 合约,处理元数据(IPFS 链下或链上)、铸造规则(总量上限、单价、单次上限)、EIP-2981 版税和市场集成,产出 Solidity 代码模板。
howto.when: 当你创建 NFT 合约、搭建 NFT 市场,或实现数字资产系统时触发;原文也提到做可转让受限的 soulbound 代币、版税分成、动态 NFT 等场景。

say.text: 给这个 NFT 合约加上 EIP-2981 版税,费率 5%
say.note: 加上 royaltyInfo 与上限校验

say.text: 用 ERC-1155 写游戏道具合约,支持批量铸造和销毁
say.note: 每个道具 ID 单独设最大供应量

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes NFT contracts using ERC-721 and ERC-1155: metadata (IPFS or on-chain), minting rules (supply caps, price, per-mint limits), EIP-2981 royalties, and marketplace integration, returning Solidity templates.
howto.when_en: Use when creating NFT contracts, building NFT marketplaces, or implementing digital asset systems; it also covers soulbound tokens, royalty splits, and dynamic NFTs.

say_en.text: Write an ERC-721 NFT contract with a supply cap and per-mint limit, metadata on IPFS
say_en.note: Returns a contract template with mint checks

say_en.text: Add EIP-2981 royalties at 5% to this NFT contract
say_en.note: Adds royaltyInfo and a fee cap check

say_en.text: Write an ERC-1155 game items contract with batch mint and burn
say_en.note: Each item id gets its own max supply
